[b]Statement of the Communist States of New Arenenge[/b]

[pre]Fox News | Gendarmite Herald | The Daily Bird[/pre]

[I]The Gendarmite Republic officially denounces the Communist States of New Arenenge for its recent aggression and violation towards the legitimacy of The Gendarmite Raj. A State of Emergency has been declared in the Gendarmite Raj and Martial law is to be enforced. The Gendarmite Colonial Police Force will be activated citizens of Arenenge have officially received a travel ban from Gendarme.  Naval Facilities in the territories of Alicia and Capricorn will be re-activated and the Argos fleet is en-route to Southern Amarallo.
[/i]

[i][b]Bulwark Government Residence, Capital of The Gendarme[/b][/i]

[i]The atmosphere of the round table remained eerie, filled with the highest ranking officials of Gendarme, all of these figures were meeting to discuss what will happen in the chance of war between Gendarme and Arenenge.  At the end of one side of the table, sat Grégoire Tremble. The Prime Minister of Gendarme and its Chief Executive. The discussion was ominous, and sitting in fear wouldn't do anything to retard a Arengese invasion.  "[b]The current state of our Colonial holdings within Amarallo is in jeopardy, new Arenenge, a third-world socialist dystopia is conspiring to attack us and spread communism all over Erene![/b]".  Grégoire said, his voice shaky and unstable. How could he keep his cool in such circumstances?, what if Gendarme were to lose? "[b]Grégoire, you are the Prime Minister of Gendarme. [u]Please[/u], inform us on what we should do. [/b]" his Minister of Economics  shot back. [b]"It is clear that the continued existence of such a malevolent state cannot stand. Arenenge must be neutralized swiftly, Gendarme [u]NEEDS[/u] to invest more into its defense and begin an organized bombing campaign to make sure that this sh*t-hole of a nation doesn't come crawling back to us ever again.[/b]" Élie Morel, the Gendarmite Minister of Defense stated. The room went silent after such a radical proposition was made, Grégoire felt as if a hundred things were running through his head all at once. When he was about to respond to Élie's statement, a sharp knock came from the door. Grégoire felt relieved, he stood up to answer the door only to see a short, dark-skinned man of Amarallan descent appear before him. His body was covered in traditional robes and gold that made Grégoire infer that he was some immigrant bystander who had mistaken the Residence for a Temple. "[b]How did you even get he-[/b]" "[b]I am Shekhar Dani, Maharaja of the Gendarmite Raj. A colonial overseas territory of the Gendarmites.[/b]" The man cut him off. Grégoire was shocked, he never met the Maharaja of the Raj, he was a lot shorter than he expected but he was to be treated with the utmost respect. This man ruled Gendarme's most important colony, if anyone knew how to deal with this, it was him. "[b]My utmost apology, your highness. We never expected you to show up in such an informal manner.  Time is of the essence your majesty, if we have kept you updated about the situation in New Arenenge, we apologize.[/b]" Grégoire bowed down towards the man to kiss his feet, a gesture of respect and modesty in the Raj. "[b]Thank you, though I do know about what is happening. That is why I came here to visit you and your fine gentlemen, my people are in danger and we will not settle for oppression by a totalitarian power ever again. I have designed a plan to rebuke any Arengese attempted invasion.[/b]" Grégoire led the man into the room, and opened a chair for him to take a seat, but the main rejected. He took out a carpet and laid it before them, then he sat down. "[b]Shall we begin?[/b]"

[pre]Gendarmite Military Personnel located within the Gendarmite Raj, Capricorn, Normandie, and Alicia have all been dispatched in favor of activity within the Raj. Coastal defenses would be re-activated, and coastal batteries will be assigned to organized naval strongholds that were most likely to be invaded by the Arengese. Meanwhile, a general mobilization within the Raj has been enforced and is expected to reach an output of 40.000 draftees by the end of January. Urlapur, the administrative capital of the Gendarmite Raj would be fortified by SAM batteries several highways would be check-pointed. The Maharaja's family would be relocated to Capricorn where military defenses would make sure that they remained unharmed in the time of war. 6/20 Submarine assets within the Gendarmite navy are to be re-activated and dispatched to the Naval Straits between the Raj and new Arenenge.[/pre]
